title: How to Scan and Track Surgical Instrument Trays in CSSD
content:
ARTICLE: How to Scan and Track Surgical Instrument Trays in CSSD (KA-022)
SYSTEM: CSSD System
DEPARTMENT: Operation Theatre
VERSION: 1.7
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the CSSD System module to execute how to scan and track surgical instrument trays in cssd safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the CSSD System client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Scan and Track Surgical Instrument Trays in CSSD and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Operation Theatre coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
